stories.title: Crisis en Ceuta y actualidad política, directo | Albares dice que trabaja con Rabat para prevenir una nueva entrada masiva a Ceuta el día 23

en.title: Crisis in Ceuta and political current events, live | Albares says he is working with Rabat to prevent another mass entry to Ceuta on the 23rd
en.summary: Spain's foreign minister is coordinating with Morocco to prevent another mass migration event to Ceuta. The government disputes the autonomous city's handling of approximately 700 children still on the streets.

stories.title: Muere la mujer que fue estrangulada por su pareja la semana pasada en Málaga

en.title: Woman who was strangled by her partner dies a week later in Málaga
en.summary: A woman who was attacked by her partner in Málaga has died after being hospitalized since her daughter called emergency services. The incident involved strangulation by her partner.

stories.title: Muere la mujer que fue estrangulada en Málaga por su pareja, que luego se quitó la vida

en.title: Woman dies after being strangled in Málaga by her partner, who later took his own life
en.summary: A 35-year-old woman died in intensive care after being strangled by her partner in their home on Wednesday. Her partner subsequently died by suicide.

stories.title: Muere el hijo de Cindy Crawford a los 27 años en un centro de rehabilitación

en.title: Son of Cindy Crawford dies at 27 in a rehabilitation center
en.summary: Presley Gerber, son of supermodel Cindy Crawford, died at age 27 in a rehabilitation facility in Los Angeles. The cause of death has not yet been confirmed pending autopsy results.

stories.title: Aduanas apresa un velero con al menos 2.000 kilos de cocaína a 400 millas de Galicia

en.title: Customs seizes sailboat with at least 2,000 kilos of cocaine 400 miles off Galicia
en.summary: Spanish customs authorities intercepted a sailboat carrying approximately 2,000 kilos of cocaine off the coast of Galicia, marking one of the largest drug seizures of its kind. The vessel's crew was arrested.

stories.title: Sánchez busca impulsar un contrato social en el uso de la IA y advierte de sus riesgos si «está en manos de unos pocos»

en.title: Sánchez seeks to promote a social contract on AI use and warns of its risks if "in the hands of a few"
en.summary: Spanish President Pedro Sánchez announced plans to convene political parties and social agents next month to create a national framework establishing a social contract governing artificial intelligence use. He warned against concentrated control of AI technology.

stories.title: Sánchez carga contra la IA en manos de "unos pocos" y fija para el mes que viene la negociación con los agentes sociales para crear un proyecto de país

en.title: Sánchez criticizes AI in the hands of "a few" and schedules negotiations with social agents for next month to create a national project
en.summary: President Sánchez concluded a presentation of Spain's AI deployment plan, criticizing concentrated AI control and scheduling upcoming talks with social agents to develop a comprehensive national strategy.

stories.title: Sánchez reclama “un nuevo contrato social” para abordar la IA: “La autorregulación no funciona”

en.title: Sánchez demands "a new social contract" to address AI: "Self-regulation does not work"
en.summary: Spanish President Sánchez presented government measures to adapt Spain to artificial intelligence technology, announcing he will convene social agents to address the matter and rejecting self-regulation as insufficient.

stories.title: Intervienen más de 2.000 kilos de cocaína en un velero a 400 millas de Galicia

en.title: Over 2,000 kilos of cocaine seized on sailboat 400 miles off Galicia
en.summary: Spanish tax authorities intercepted a sailboat carrying more than 2,000 kilos of cocaine approximately 400 miles off the coast of Galicia. The vessel was located by a customs surveillance ship and brought to the port of Vigo, with crew members detained and the drugs turned over to judicial authorities.

stories.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, dies at 27

en.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, dies at 27
en.summary: Presley Gerber, a model and brother of model Kaia Gerber, has died at age 27. He had previously been open about struggling with mental health and addiction issues.

stories.title: Muere Presley Gerber, hijo de Cindy Crawford, a los 27 años

en.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, dies at 27
en.summary: The model and brother of Kaia Gerber, who had publicly discussed mental health struggles, died while in rehabilitation.

stories.title: Los altos directivos sitúan a España entre sus países preferidos de Europa para invertir

en.title: Senior executives rank Spain among Europe's preferred countries for investment
en.summary: A Deutsche Bank survey of 1,200 senior executives found Spain in the top 5 European destinations for investment. Business leaders view Europe as offering economic stability and resilience compared to other regions.

stories.title: La guerra civil entre cárteles que está desgarrando un estado mexicano

en.title: The civil war between cartels that is tearing apart a Mexican state
en.summary: A conflict within the Sinaloa cartel erupted in 2024 when Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán's son kidnapped the organization's co-founder and handed him over to U.S. authorities.

stories.title: Sánchez: "Una IA desregulada y opaca es el cóctel perfecto para que ocurra una desgracia"

en.title: Sánchez: "An unregulated and opaque AI is the perfect cocktail for disaster to occur"
en.summary: The Spanish government president presented an AI360 plan and announced plans to convene social agents in October to promote a national agreement on artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Cox derrota a Ghana y logra un laudo favorable de más de 200 millones

en.title: Cox defeats Ghana and achieves a favorable arbitration award of over 200 million
en.summary: The company won two arbitration proceedings related to a desalination plant project in Accra and a state guarantee backing a water sales contract with a Ghanaian public company.

stories.title: Unicaja e Ibercaja cobran un 50% más en dividendo de Caser

en.title: Unicaja and Ibercaja receive 50% more in Caser dividends
en.summary: The insurance company increased shareholder dividends by 120% following its merger with Helvetia.
